justification: Zero ranking deficits identified across benchmark. Relevant chunks are consistently positioned at Rank #1-#2 by dense vector + sparse FTS + RRF. An external neural cross-encoder would add ~200-400ms latency without providing any recall improvement.

recommendations.recommendedAction: DO NOT adopt an active reranker model in production at this stage. Keep RRF hybrid retrieval as the primary engine. Document reranker architecture for future scale (100k+ chunks).
